headline: Ravens place promising rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane on IR
summary: The Ravens placed Ja'Kobi Lane on IR after the promising rookie had surgery on his fractured wrist.

headline: Trey Hendrickson, Zay Flowers, Ronnie Stanley among Ravens out of practice Wednesday
summary: The Ravens had six players out of practice on Wednesday.

headline: Seahawks Rule Out QB Sam Darnold For Week 2
summary: As expected, the Seahawks will be without their starting quarterback in Week 2. Head coach Mike Macdonald confirmed on Wednesday that Sam Darnold will miss Seattle’s upcoming game against the Cardinals. headline: Vikings RB Jordan Mason put on IR after having surgery on thumb
summary: Vikings running back Jordan Mason was placed on injured reserve Wednesday after undergoing surgery to repair a fractured thumb.

headline: Colts' Keenan Allen formally charged, faces two misdemeanors
summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was formally charged with two misdemeanor drunken driving charges on Wednesday.

headline: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for the season, WR De'Zhaun Stribling out around 10 weeks
summary: Initial word on 49ers tight end Jake Tonges's knee injury was that it would keep him out for an extended period of time and head coach Kyle Shanahan provided an update on where things stand at a Wednesday press conference.
